title: 2024 final evaluation: selected saved evidence
scope: Examiner-facing selection of completed results. Reads saved tables only; no detector execution, scientific replay or full-study aggregation was rerun.

design.exposure: one continuous background per pass; counterparts contribute zero primary exposure
design.scoring: submitted A4/C1-C6; saved complete predictions; raw episodes before private labels

limitations: Humidity remains originally A2-ineligible and exploratory; the negative 2023 finding is retained.
Background is assumed normal, not certified healthy.
The final period is not a newly untouched holdout.
Scenario construction, root detection, point detection and false-positive burden have different units and denominators.
No causal physical-sensor diagnosis, operational alarm acceptability or participant-tested usability is established.
